name: WaivOps NRG-CP

evidence.statement: Zenodo publishes version 1.0 of the NRG-CP record and identifies the acquisition archive by name and MD5.
Publisher states that the dataset was compiled by WaivOps, managed by Patchbanks, and that recordings were sourced from verified composers and providers for copyright clearance.
CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation for commercial purposes subject to attribution and the other license terms.

blockers: Obtain SHA-256 for the downloaded acquisition archive.
Establish that the licensor had authority to grant commercial training and redistribution rights for all contained MIDI material, not merely that the dataset page displays CC BY 4.0.
Build and verify the complete MIDI inventory with per-file SHA-256 checksums and an exact manifest match.
